name: Strawberry Pie
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Place your strawberries in a saucepan and add water, sugar, and lemon juice. Bring to a boil and stir occasionally until thick and syrupy.
Arrange the pie crust in a pie pan (unless the pie crust comes with a pan). Pour filling into the pie crust.
Bake in the oven at 350°F for 60 minutes or until golden brown. Remove pie, and let it cool.
Serve with whipped cream on top.
